proposed_function: Self-assembly and phase separation via multivalent interactions
evidence: Its disordered C-terminal low-complexity domain (LCD, residues 267–414), rich in glycine, glutamine/asparagine, and serine, bears features of a prion-like region and plays a central role in self-assembly of the protein and in the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases [ 3, 4 ].
curator_note: Exact positions given (residues 267-414). Corresponds to canonical TDP-43 LCD.
